title: Citadels for Crisis Fragments
summary: Find Citadels in the Atlas fog by their beams and kill their bosses for the three Crisis Fragments that open The Burning Monolith. High waystone drop chance is the lever guides name for more fragments.

budget.why: Waystones with high drop chance and the maps around the Citadels; nothing else is consumed.
budget.build_needs: Kills the Citadel bosses (Doryani, Count Geonor, Jamanra).

nodes.name: Head of the Snake
nodes.effect: Pinnacle Bosses have 25% chance to drop an additional Unique item; Powerful Map Bosses have 5% chance when defeated to reveal a nearby Citadel; Pinnacle Bosses have a single Revive

claim.note: Our pick: Head of the Snake is the one master node that reveals Citadels. maxroll's guide (updated 2026-06-06, before 0.5.5) names Jado's Spycraft instead; not measured.

waystone.notes: maxroll advises waystones with high waystone drop chance for more fragments. The '300–400% drop chance for two fragments per kill' figure is a creator claim, not verified.

claim.note: maxroll (Cptn Garbage, updated 2026-06-06) for the advice; Mezuman (2026-09-29) for the numbers, which are community figures.

steps: Set Doryani with Head of the Snake (T4): Powerful Map Bosses can reveal a nearby Citadel.
Look for Citadel beams in the Atlas fog: red for the Stone Citadel (Doryani), blue for the Iron Citadel (Count Geonor), orange for the Copper Citadel (Jamanra).
Run the Citadel with a high waystone-drop-chance waystone and kill its boss for a Crisis Fragment.
Sell the fragments on the exchange, or place Ancient, Faded and Weathered in The Burning Monolith to fight The Arbiter of Ash.
risks: The number of fragments per kill and its link to waystone drop chance are community figures, not verified.
